description: Make several charts at once and put each on a portal's dashboard as a card: «make me a dashboard», «a chart for each metric». ONE call for all of them. Each chart: a name, a type, its table, the field along the X axis (a date or a number field puts each record's value there; a dropdown, radio or checkbox field one bar per choice) and the number field(s) it shows. The whole call is checked first: a table or a field that is not there, a series over a field that holds no number, or a name the project's charts already have makes nothing, and the answer says which. Up to 30 charts.

name.description: The chart's name, also the card's caption — in the person's language

series.description: One line or bar each: a number field of the same table

color.description: #hex; left out, a muted colour of ours

type_code.description: line, bar, column, area, pie, doughnut, scatter (default line)

x_field.description: The field along the X axis (id or name)

portal_id.description: The portal whose dashboard gets the cards; may be left out when the project has one portal

name: create_dashboard_charts
